editorial.message: pipeline.n2 opens with filler ('Utility statements require a distinction') and hedges the source with 'commonly'; the source says every other statement is wrapped unchanged in a CMD_UTILITY Query.
pipeline.n1 says parse analysis uses a snapshot; the page says analysis pushes a snapshot only if it needs one.
index-cost.n2 adds a disclaimer ('not recommendations for a server's settings') that the cited text does not state; the page makes a similar point only for the 1.1 setting in the diagnosis chapter.
sublinks.n2 says the page's two examples 'return the same rows'; the page only shows both plans and says NOT NULL declarations are not examined. Consider dropping the clause.
cte-choice.n2 closing sentence ('The spelling of WITH alone does not tell you which behavior applies') is a synthesized takeaway; it adds no fact but is not in the source.
parallel-jit.n1 says the leader runs the plan with fewer workers; the source adds the condition that this holds with no workers or when the leader participates.
Screen line 4 says width affects costs; the narration does not cover width, and the source ties width to byte estimates deciding work_mem fit, which only indirectly affects cost.

summary: All 296 targets judged against the pinned document and glossary. 294 are supported and 2 are not factual (framing), none contradicted. Shortening kept the required qualifications (forced settings labels, estimated versus measured, source-only notes, no-LLVM, 17-cycle additions). Only minor wording issues remain: pipeline.n1/n2 hedges, an added disclaimer in index-cost.n2, an inferred clause in sublinks.n2, a synthesized takeaway in cte-choice.n2, and a dropped leader-participation condition in parallel-jit.n1.
